rows.text: “For the fourth quarter of 2026, we expect revenue of $25.0 million to $26.5 million, attaining a $100.0 million revenue run rate while generating GAAP diluted earnings per share of $0.53 to $0.57 and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $0.57 to $0.61.

We revise our guidance for the full-year 2026, expecting to report revenue of $91.6 million to $93.1 million from $91.0 million to $96.0 million, and GAAP diluted earnings per share to $1.90 to $1.94 from $1.90 to $2.05 and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share to $2.07 to $2.11 from $2.06 to $2.21,” added Mr.
